newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ekran profit boosted by fees -analysts.
newsitem.headline: Ekran profit boosted by fees -analysts.

text.p: Ekran Bhd's results for its latest financial year were significantly boosted by fees related to the Bakun hydro-electric dam, analysts said on Tuesday.

On Monday, the main contractor of Malaysia's Bakun dam released results for the year ended June 30, 1996. It reported a 98 percent rise in net profit to 128.66 million ringgit from 65.01 million a year ago.
Turnover at the timber and construction concern rose 77 percent to 556.35 million ringgit versus 313.70 million ringgit.

Management fees and Bakun related works comprised half of revenue "and more than 75 percent of pretax profit," a report from HLG Securities on Tuesday said. Ekran reported a 116 percent rise in pre-tax profits to 201.67 million ringgit for the year.
The fees were related to technical and feasibility studies and preliminary resettlement activities.
The 2,400 MW capacity Bakun dam is expected to begin operating in the year 2003. Its building will displace some tribal peoples who live in Sarawak state on Borneo island.
"Once Bakun commences, Ekran's fees will be derived from both timber clearing and construction works at Bakun in addition to its regular construction works," HLG said.
